title: Addressing Imbalance in Health Data: Synthetic Minority Oversampling using Deep Learning (ACVAE)
summary: Code accompanying a paper proposing ACVAE, an Auxiliary-guided Conditional Variational Autoencoder with contrastive learning for synthetic minority oversampling on imbalanced health datasets, evaluated against SMOTE variants and other baselines. Its preprocessing pipeline directly imports rdt.transformers' ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder to encode mixed-type tabular columns before training.
evidence: ACVAE.py:31 'from rdt.transformers import ClusterBasedNormalizer, OneHotEncoder' used to transform columns before ACVAE training
needs: Full ACVAE.py not shown; assumed rdt transformers are actually fit/transformed in the pipeline beyond the import line.
